content:
**Long Shot** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increases accuracy and range when aiming scopes. Although not stated, the accuracy is improved by 30%.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Your scoped weapons have 30% more range and accuracy when aiming. | 002A1DBE | 

Before update 60, the perk worked only with rifles. It provided 10%/20%/30% more range and 10%/20%/30% more accuracy when aiming down sights.
